If they had, we might not have survived.|Leia Organa|<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer''' was a variant of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] equipped with [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:InterdictorSDHyperspace-VQ.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darth Vader's Interdictor en route to [[Jazbina/Legends|Jazbina]]]]
[[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] already produced an Interdictor, the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] based on a 600-meter [[Vindicator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Vindicator''-class heavy cruiser]] (also used for the [[Enforcer-class picket cruiser|''Enforcer''-class picket cruiser]]). Though it was decently armed for its size, it was a high-priority vessel that was generally unable to hold its own in combat, especially if the battle involved [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] and comparable vessels.

To make room for the gravity well projectors, half of the [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], as well as eight of the [[Phylon Freight/Legends|Phylon]] [[Q7 tractor beam projector/Legends|Q7 tractor beam projectors]] found on the original ''Imperial''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], had to be removed.<ref name="Starships of the Galaxy">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref> The ''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer's reduced hangar held sixteen [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]].<ref name="OaAI" />

[[File:Dominator_attacked.png|thumb|right|200px|''Dominator'' is attacked by a pair of Rogue Squadron X-wings.]]
The ''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer did not require additional support when performing patrol and customs duties. Some bold commanders such as [[Loka Hask]] even used the ship to pull armed convoys out of hyperspace and destroy them.

Nonetheless, like the Immobilizer, the gravity wells remained a major drain on the ship's main reactor, with the vessel only being able to sustain its Gravity wells for a single day. This had the potential to compromise defenses in heavy combat. For instance, while Loka Hask's [[Dominator (Interdictor-class)|''Dominator'']] had interdicted and was destroying a New Republic Convoy, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] counterattacked by hitting ''Dominator'' with a salvo of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]]. While an Imperial Star Destroyer's [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] would have easily held up against such an assault, ''Dominator''{{'s}} shields partially collapsed, and the hull took some damage, prompting its commanders to call off the battle. Rogue Squadron also successfully used this tactic on the Immobilizer 418 cruiser ''[[Aggregator]]'', which caused it to retreat.

==History==
[[File:Interdicted-FFG.png|thumb|left|200px|An Interdictor creating an [[Interdiction field/Legends|interdiction field]]]]
Since its conception, the ''Interdictor''-class played a significant role in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Commanders frequently used these ships against pirate insurrections and small pockets of resistance. Because this ship's capabilities prevented other ships from escaping, these vessels were also extensively used in raids and invasions. However, despite their capabilities, they were relatively rare in the greater [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], mostly due to them "building big." [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], a high-ranking member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], later noted that it was a hidden blessing for the Rebels that the Empire did not mass-produce the ''Interdictor''-class and similar vessels.

A ship of this class was used as a [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the months immediately after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but it was destroyed above Jazbina by Rebel pilot [[Jal Te Gniev]].

[[File:XWRS32-FC.jpg|thumb|right|180px|''Binder'' takes part in the [[evacuation of Ciutric]].]]
An Interdictor Star Destroyer participated in the [[Battle of the Graveyard]] against [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]]. The Star Destroyer's gravity well projectors, which kept the Rebel fleet from fleeing, were destroyed. A few participated in the [[Attack on Bannistar Station]].

In the months immediately after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], ships of this class, such as ''Dominator'' and ''[[Binder]]'', seemed to have been specifically deployed in Imperial efforts to defeat the Rebels' legendary Rogue Squadron.

By [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|fleet]] at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]] included a number of ''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyers.

Thrawn used these ships in many of his attacks in his campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Thrawn ingeniously used these craft on multiple occasions to pull his own ships out of hyperspace, making the jump more efficient, because the incoming vessels could scramble into a situation with almost unprecedented precision.

==Behind the scenes==
Before a [[Star Wars Legends|canonical]] designation was known, [[Curtis Saxton]] documented this ship class on his [[Curtis Saxton|Star Wars Technical Commentaries]] website.<ref name="TFN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/swtc/dagger.html#dominator|text=Star Wars Technical Commentaries|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/v7eL7}}</ref> On his site, Saxton used the provisional name "''Dominator''-class Star Destroyer," created after the class's first named representative, ''[[Dominator (Interdictor-class)|Dominator]]''.

The listing of known ships is controversial since ''Binder'', [[Constrainer/Legends|''Constrainer'']], and [[Sentinel (Interdictor cruiser)|''Sentinel'']] were labeled as Interdictors, and presumed to be Immobilizer 418 cruisers in the novels. They were drawn as Interdictor Star Destroyers in the [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]] comic series. However, more corroborating evidence concerning this matter is based on these vessels and the way they are depicted in [[Star Wars: Empire at War|''Empire at War'']] as Immobilizer 418 ships. The matter is still conjectural.
